title: Angloromani
description: Para-Romani dialect spoken by the Romanichal
extract: Angloromani or Anglo-Romani is a Para-Romani dialect spoken by the Romanichal, a subgroup of the Romani people in the United Kingdom and other parts of the English-speaking world. It is characterised by the presence of Romani vocabulary and syntax in the English used by Romanichal.
